name: Konoe Kagami
source:
Kagami is the mother of [url=/c6468]Nanami[/url] who runs a kissaten or coffee shop right across the street from their house. She has a kind and gentle personality. Because of her youthful appearance, she is commonly mistaken as Nanami's elder sister. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamune_%28anime%29#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
